summary: Core redaction behavior is implemented and validated: a central redactor exists, WorkspaceLogSink redacts before persistence and metadata updates, LogBroadcaster redacts direct live frames, focused unit tests cover representative secret patterns, and the required pytest, ruff, and mypy commands pass. The saved plan is not fully satisfied because chunk-boundary token splitting was called out as needing either hardening coverage or explicit residual-risk documentation, and the current stateless per-write redactor has neither.
gaps: Either make WorkspaceLogSink redaction safe across write boundaries or explicitly document chunk-boundary redaction as a residual risk per the saved plan; currently redact_secrets('ghp_FA') + redact_secrets('KEgithubTokenValue123456') yields the full token, so adjacent sink writes can persist an unredacted GitHub token.
